title: VisualReviewRecord
description: One recorded visual pass, against one frame.

contractSignoff.description:
THE STAGE-1 CONTRACT VERSION this verdict was taken against: the sign-off row whose hash is the signed frame the reviewer compared to.

The pipeline is four stages in fixed order - contract JSON, then Figma AND code built to it, then source-side gates, then this artefact-side visual check - and the stages must be LINKED, not parallel. A verdict that cannot name its contract version is how "we checked it" survives a contract change with nobody noticing: the frame is redrawn, the contract moves, and a verdict rendered against the old one keeps reading as coverage.

`Option` because a `no_authority` verdict is precisely the state of having NO contract to cite, and forcing a citation there would teach a pipeline to invent one. Any other verdict without it is invalid.

deltas.description: What differed, one delta per line. Required non-empty for `deviate` and required EMPTY for `conform`: a verdict and its evidence may not disagree.

frameDigest.description: The frame's content digest at review time, as the frames ledger computes it. The frame side's input hash.

frameImageDigest.description: Hash of the exported frame image the reviewer saw.

nodeId.description: The frame reviewed against, in the `12:34` spelling.

regions.description:
Which bands of the pair were examined, and what was found in each.

Required non-empty. A verdict with no region checklist is a verdict about "the page", and a finding about the page cannot be told apart from a glance at the page.

reviewedBy.description: The reviewing agent's identity: model, harness, prompt version.

routes.description:
The route(s) this pass covered, as the screens ledger spells them.

A LIST so a grouped verdict is representable and refusable by name. Read the module note: a single-route field would have made the family review that motivated this amendment impossible to write down and impossible to catch. Exactly one route confers coverage; more confers none.

shippedScreenshotDigest.description: Hash of the shipped screenshot artefact itself.

shippedSourceDigest.description: The screens-ledger digest of the route's SOURCE at review time. The shipped side's input hash: when the route's source moves, this no longer matches the ledger and the verdict is STALE.

verdict.description: The reviewer's verdict. `no_authority` is recordable - a pipeline that found the frame unsigned says so honestly - and the proof also DERIVES authority itself; a recorded `conform` against a frame the register shows unsigned is refused, not trusted.

AuthorityVerdict.description:
The verdict vocabulary of every frame-bound proof. CLOSED at three.

There is deliberately no fourth variant for an accepted deviation. An acceptance state is taste exercised downstream of sign-off, which the constitutional direction forbids: the resolution path for a deviation is a new signed frame version, recorded as a [`RedrawRecord`].

oneOf.description: The shipped artefact matches the signed frame.
The shipped artefact differs from the signed frame. An ADDITION the frame omits is a deviation exactly like a missing element; direction carries no excuse.
The frame is unsigned, parked, or a proposal: there is no authority to conform to. Never green, never red; reported as coverage owed.

RegionFinding.description: What the reviewer found in one region, or that they did not look.

examined.description:
Whether this region of the PAIR was actually compared.

`false` is a first-class, recordable answer and is the whole point: "capture debt, needs seeded data" is a legitimate thing to conclude about a region, and it has to be readable as a region that was not studied rather than disappearing into a verdict about the page.

finding.description: The finding, or the reason the region was not examined. Required either way: a region row carrying neither is a row that says nothing.

ReviewId.description: A visual review verdict: automated eyes over a shipped screen against its signed frame (draft S-7D).

ReviewRegion.description:
The bands of a screen a visual pass is expected to account for. CLOSED.

Closed for the reason [`super::SurfaceKind`] is: an open set of region names lets one undifferentiated "the page" bucket back in, and "the page looks fine" is exactly the finding that missed a counted facet row, a counted eyebrow, date-group bands and a footer window statement on one route.

These are ANATOMY names and hold no design value (VDS S-2(4)): a region is a place to look, never a size, a colour or a spacing.

oneOf.description: The page header band: title, eyebrow, counts, primary actions.
The filter/facet band, and whatever counts it carries.
The body rows or cards, and their internal anatomy.
The side rail, where the frame draws one.
The footer band, and any window or scope statement in it.
The empty state, which is a drawn state and not an absence.
Keyboard affordances drawn in the frame: focus rings, hints, shortcuts.

SignoffId.description: A frame sign-off: the frame's content hash at the moment taste was exercised (draft S-7D).

Timestamp.description: UTC, second resolution, trailing Z. The one canonical form VDS writes.
